anomalies.observed: R36 is valued "24k" in the netlist and SPICE deck, but its library description and MPN both describe a 24 ohm part (FRC0805J240TSD, '240' = 24R). Its footprint is 0805 with a 150V rating.
anomalies.expected: The value field should match the selected part. A 24k value needs a 24k part (e.g. FRC0805J243 style MPN), or the value should be 24R if the 24R part is what was intended.

evidence.quote: (description " 125mW Thick Film Resistors 150V ±100ppm/℃ ±5% 24Ω 0805 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS")

anomalies.impact: The resistor across the VOUTN/VOUTP bank is either 1000x lower than intended (a 24 ohm load that would bleed the supercap-type bank far too quickly) or the BOM will be populated with a part that does not match the drawing. Either way the intended bleed or balance current is wrong.

anomalies.observed: C45 carries an explicit Tolerance field of 20% and a description of ±20%, while its MPN CC0603KRX7R0BB223 (the 'K' code) is the ±10% part used by its sibling balancing capacitors C42, C44 and C46.
anomalies.expected: Tolerance and part number should agree. The sibling 22nF 100V balancing capacitors are ±10% parts with the same MPN.

evidence.quote: (description " 100V 22nF X7R ±20% 0603 Multilayer Ceramic Capacitors MLCC - SMD/SMT ROHS ")

anomalies.impact: Minor. The cell-balancing capacitor on VC2 may be ±20% rather than ±10%, which slightly widens the balancing spread. No functional failure is expected.

parsed.summary: The most likely anomaly is R36, whose value field reads 24k while its description and MPN describe a 24 ohm part, which would change the bleed or load on the VOUTN/VOUTP bank by three orders of magnitude. A minor tolerance inconsistency on C45 is also noted at low confidence; the rest of the power, CAN, e-stop, USB and sensor wiring looks consistent with the spec.
